policy.title: Trump’s Illegal Tariffs Delivered 85% of Apple’s Earnings Beat
policy.summary_zh: 川普政府的非法關稅措施實際上為蘋果等科技硬體廠商帶來保護與獲利支撐,反映出在地製造與供應鏈本地化政策的實際效果。

policy.title: The Trump Administration Has Created a De Facto Licensing System for Frontier AI Models
policy.summary_zh: 川普政府建立針對前沿 AI 模型的『事實許可制』,推高企業自主開發與替代方案的需求,間接利好醫療、國防等特定領域的獨立軟體廠商。

policy.title: The EU's Regulatory Crackdown on Google Escalates From Fines to Damages, With Other U.S. Big Tech Firms Also Facing Mounting Pressure
